resources.string: Lumio asks providers in this order and moves to the next one if a provider fails. Drag to change the order.
Every library and font AirVault ships, with the licence each one is used under.

Balance reads on EVM chains ask the first provider that answers. Routescan, Etherscan, Blockscout and 3xpl are explorers, and Blockchair serves Ethereum too. Every provider that is asked for a read sees the address it is asked about, and so does each RPC provider that a read reaches. Etherscan answers only with a key of your own. A chain whose RPC address you set in EVM settings is read from that address alone, so no public provider sees it.
On: balance reads use the RPC providers only, so no explorer sees them. Off is the default, and the explorers are asked first.
